stage: Exploratory mechanism screen on four previously observed development identities, frozen before generation
selection: Lowest mean absolute RGB error on a common set of held-out visible patches; ties prefer smaller radius. The probe pixels are zeroed before model access. No target or gallery access. Restore all probe context before the final generation.
support: Euclidean dilation of a coverage-pooled native missing mask; every supplied missing pixel stays covered. All arms compose into the original 512-pixel mask and preserve all other bytes.
budget: Candidate costs four probe generations plus one final generation. seed_mean5 costs five original-mask seeds. support_mean5 averages four radii plus a radius-4 generation with seed+10000; support_mean4 is a cheaper four-call control. All fixed controls share the candidate final bank; candidate selection cannot inspect it.
selection_failure: If fewer than four full probes fit, or any calibration generation fails, use radius zero and record abstention. Every generation failure stays in the ledger; a failed final/control output is not silently replaced or dropped.
statistics: Average both seeds within identity before paired bootstrap/exact sign flips. Eight prespecified tests, Holm correction. Missing seed pairs exclude that identity only from that contrast and report coverage; gate requires complete coverage. Four identities cannot establish statistical superiority.
progression_gate: Exploratory only: on EACH seed, context_selected must beat EVERY fixed-radius and both five-call controls by at least 0.005 mean FaceNet and 2 percent relative mean hole-MAE reduction; gallery similarity may fall by at most 0.002 and LPIPS may rise by at most 1 percent. All eight case-seed selections, generations, metrics and face detections must succeed without abstention. Passing permits a separate, frozen unfamiliar-development confirmation, never immediate publication or website promotion.
secondary: All metrics/detection failures, timing, per-case probe errors, chosen radius, probe-loss versus actual-hole-MAE rank correlation, all fixed-radius controls and local visual sheets. Correlation uses evaluation truth only after selection is locked and is descriptive, not a tuning signal.
clean_target_access: Only separate evaluator and visual report may read target/gallery. Generation uses only observed image and supplied mask. No supplied reference pixels are read in this single-image support screen.
novelty_boundary: Self-supervised calibration, internal-image adaptation and mask perturbation have prior art. This tests a narrower frozen-generator mask-support policy; benefit, novelty and unknown-client accuracy remain hypotheses. Held-out-context fidelity need not predict missing-feature identity.
